purpose: Image mockup for review before implementation
originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished full-page desktop website mockup for Russian project «ОРБИТА», edge to edge, crisp readable Cyrillic, no browser or device frame. Tall scrolling page, about 1440 × 3400.

The site showcases interactive 3D design through Mars, retains an atlas of three planets, and ends with Telegram contact @webdiz3d. Show three key moments of one continuous scroll-driven scene.

Pinned direction: nearly black background, crimson and vivid red accents, warm off-white text. Monumental editorial sans serif typography, disciplined whitespace, quiet dividers, cinematic rocky Mars with red grazing light. Borrow the confidence and compact controls of a premium interactive creative studio, creating original composition and imagery. Mars is the dominant visual.

Reading order:
Header: «ОРБИТА» left; «АТЛАС», Telegram paper-plane control and «МЕНЮ» with circular control right.
Hero: large dramatically lit Mars, asymmetric monumental headline «БЛИЖЕ К МАРСУ.», supporting «Космос через форму и движение», red «Исследовать ↓» button, scroll hint, pause control, discreet «01 / 03».
Middle chapter: closer cropped Mars surface with «ДРУГАЯ ПЕРСПЕКТИВА» and «02 / 03», distinct spatial arrangement.
Atlas: «ТРИ МИРА», labeled tabs «Земля», «Марс», «Сатурн», Mars selected red. Include a compact Mars image, «Красный мир. Большие вопросы.» and source link «NASA ↗». Only Saturn has rings.
Grand finale: Mars recedes into black, discreet «03 / 03». Large «ПРОДОЛЖИМ ОБЩЕНИЕ?», clearly legible exact «@webdiz3d», red «Написать в Telegram ↗». Footer «ОРБИТА · Визуализации художественные».

A polished usable website, not a poster or moodboard. Strong hierarchy and realistic controls. No sci-fi dashboard clutter, blue UI, unrelated ornaments, fabricated testimonials or metrics. Preserve the exact Telegram username.
prompt:
